GYRA MK1

600 mm rubber-tyred spherical robot: pendulum drive, levelled sensor spine, scissored CMG pair.

Pose the mechanism

0° The drive motors push against the yoke. It swings forward and gravity rolls the tyre. Hard stop ±75°.
0° A worm drive slides the 10.9 kg battery + lead bob along a ±30° arc. That leans the robot, and precession turns it.
0° Near 0°: pure roll torque (wobble damping). Parked at ±90° and swept together: pure yaw torque (turn in place).
0% Tyre halves, pods, CMG modules and the bob pull apart along their assembly directions.

Bodies

Tyre: spins about the axle Spine: axle, pods, CMGs, kept level Yoke: pendulum pitch body, drive train Bob: battery + lead, lateral lean
